node.statement: For an enumeration C={j_1,...,j_q} and U_r={j_1,...,j_r}, finite induction constructs for every 1 <= r <= q a current reset isomorphism v_{U_r}:M_r->A_{U_r} with epsilon_{U_r}=W.L*epsilon, d_{U_r} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_r}, and ||v_{U_r}(I_{M_r})-u_{A_{U_r}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_r}.
